findings.text: follow-on: the sibling test test_preprocess_frames_cli_shot_ids (tests/test_preprocess.py:470) carries the same wrong-patch-target shape this node repaired -- it sets paths_mod.LEVEL1_DIR to a synthetic root but never rebinds the CLI module copy, so it reads the real level-1 corpus as src_root and fails with AssertionError: assert False. It is one of the two pre-existing failures on this node's own module gate and is already listed among the non-timeout failures of ped-timeout-suite-capped.html. Recorded here so the repair this node made to its sibling is on the record for that test's owner; not fixed, as it lies outside this node's declared write scope (the single target test only).

follow-on: imas_ambix/data/cli.py imports LEVEL1_DIR and LEVEL2_DIR from imas_ambix.data.paths into its own module namespace at import (lines 27-28) and its preprocess paths read the module-level name (lines 630, 720), so any test that monkeypatches only imas_ambix.data.paths.LEVEL1_DIR silently misses and exercises the real corpus. The rebind-through-the-module convention this node applies is the workaround; a lazy reference through the paths module at call time would let a single patch site work. Product-side fragility, out of this node's test-only scope, reported for the module's owner.
